purpose: Editorial review observations, not verified Medicare benefit or carrier facts. Validate substantive claims against authoritative sources before publication.

pages.finding: Existing state page already includes a carrier table and quote CTA. Year-labelled deductible values differ from the national Plan G page; headline lowest price also differs from the table minimum. Prioritize source/date reconciliation and price methodology before expanding copy.

Existing carrier page includes availability, underwriting-brand, discount and review claims. Validate each against current carrier documentation before positioning it as a 2027 buying recommendation; do not infer availability from historical keyword volume.

Existing comparison has a deductible labelled as an out-of-pocket maximum and a simplified savings scenario. Review labels, excluded costs, switching qualifications and arithmetic with authoritative benefit sources before extending the comparison.
Existing page already explains quote assumptions, pricing methods and replacement eligibility. Recommend focused update/link refinement after query-to-page checks, not another generic cost article.
